title: Crown and Oath
author: August Yarrow
blurb: Odile Okafor, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
